prompt: Write a recorded statement transcript (about 250 words) between an insurance adjuster (lines start with 'Q:') and the claimant (lines start with 'A:'). The claimant was the driver in a parking lot collision in Sugar Land, Texas, and has wrist fracture. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1245; do not mention it.)
text:
Q: Thanks for taking the time to speak with me today. This call is being recorded for claim purposes. Do you understand and agree to that?

A: Yes, I understand.

Q: Good. Can you tell me in your own words what happened at the parking lot?

A: I was backing out of a spot at the shopping center in Sugar Land. I checked my mirrors and didn't see anything, so I started slowly reversing. Then I felt a bump and heard a crunch on the driver's side.

Q: Did you see the other vehicle before the impact?

A: No. It came from the next row over, and it was behind a row of cars. I only saw it after we hit.

Q: Were you wearing your seatbelt?

A: Yes, I was.

Q: What did you do after the collision?

A: I put the car in park and got out to look. The other driver was already out and we exchanged insurance information. I was pretty shaken up, and my right wrist started hurting pretty badly.

Q: Did you go to a doctor or an urgent care facility?

A: Yes, I went to an urgent care clinic that afternoon. They took X-rays and said I had a fracture in my wrist. They put me in a splint and referred me to an orthopedic specialist.

Q: Have you had any follow-up treatment since then?

A: Yes, I've seen the orthopedist twice now. I'm supposed to keep the splint on and do physical therapy starting next week.

Q: Is there anything else you'd like to add about the accident?

A: No, I think that covers it. I just want to make sure my medical bills get taken care of.

Q: Understood. Thank you for your cooperation. We'll follow up with you soon.

A: Thank you.
